Let \(a=p+2\), \(b=2p+1\). Identify \(M_{a,b}(F)\) with
\[
R=F[x,y]/(x^a,y^b),
\]
so that \(\Phi\) is, up to harmless transpose/sign conventions for nilpotent Jordan blocks, multiplication by
\[
z=x-y.
\]
Thus the Jordan block sizes of \(\Phi\) are the invariant factors of \(R\) as an \(F[z]\)-module.

Write \(y=x-z\). Then
\[
R\simeq F[z,x]/\bigl(x^{p+2},(x-z)^{2p+1}\bigr).
\]
Over characteristic \(p\),
\[
(x-z)^{2p+1}=(x-z)(x^p-z^p)^2.
\]
Modulo \(x^{p+2}\), this becomes
\[
h=-2z^p x^{p+1}+2z^{p+1}x^p+z^{2p}x-z^{2p+1}.
\]
Using the \(F[z]\)-basis \(1,x,\dots,x^{p+1}\), the relations are \(h,xh,\dots,x^{p+1}h\). Elementary Smith reduction of this relation matrix gives invariant factors
\[
z^p,\quad z^{p+2},\quad
\underbrace{z^{2p},\dots,z^{2p}}_{p-3\text{ times}},\quad
z^{3p-2},\quad z^{3p},\quad z^{3p+2}.
\]
For completeness, the reduction uses pivots \(z^p\), then \(z^{p+2}\), then \(p-3\) pivots \(z^{2p}\). The remaining \(3\times3\) block is, up to units,
\[
z^{3p-2}
\begin{pmatrix}
z^2&0&1\\
z^3&z^2&0\\
0&z^3&z^2
\end{pmatrix},
\]
whose Smith factors are \(z^{3p-2},z^{3p},z^{3p+2}\).

Since multiplication by \(z\) on \(F[z]/(z^m)\) is one nilpotent Jordan block of size \(m\), the Jordan canonical form is
\[
\boxed{
J_p\oplus J_{p+2}\oplus (p-3)J_{2p}\oplus J_{3p-2}\oplus J_{3p}\oplus J_{3p+2}
}.
\]
The dimensions check:
\[
p+(p+2)+(p-3)2p+(3p-2)+3p+(3p+2)=(p+2)(2p+1).
\]
